# simula

> CLI-first synthetic data generator: taxonomy build → strategy build → per-point sample →
> meta-prompt → generate record → critic/refine → dedupe/trim → JSON/JSONL artifacts. With
> `generation.meta_prompts: false` the meta-prompt step is skipped and several records are written per
> call straight from their sampled points (the combined path, the cheapest setup). With
> `generation.subject` set, each record also gets a situation (the concrete thing it is about), listed
> per node of the subject factor so records sharing a node differ. One YAML
> config drives everything. There are three model roles — `strategic`, `bulk`, `critic` — not four;
> record generation is the `bulk` role (the `generator_model` row field is the bulk model id).

The docs below are the source of truth — read them rather than this file.

## Agents

- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): process + decision playbook for driving a generation run for a user — what to
  ask, what to default, when to bring the user in. Start here to *use* the tool.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): architecture, hard constraints, behaviors, and debugging. Read before
  *changing* the code.

## Docs

- [docs/index.md](docs/index.md): the documentation site (Sphinx + MyST, built by Read the Docs).
- [docs/concepts/pipeline.md](docs/concepts/pipeline.md): the stages of a run, attempts, stop/edit/continue,
  resume. The other `docs/concepts/` pages cover the taxonomy, sampling, situations and meta-prompts, model
  roles and evaluation (incl. the lineage-vs-verified coverage caveat).
- [docs/guides/batching.md](docs/guides/batching.md) and [docs/guides/cost.md](docs/guides/cost.md): what
  batch sizes trade, where the money goes, measured pilot numbers.
- [docs/reference/configuration.md](docs/reference/configuration.md): exhaustive per-field config reference.
- [docs/reference/artifacts.md](docs/reference/artifacts.md): every output file and the dataset row shape.
- [examples/template.yaml](examples/template.yaml): copy-me config skeleton, every key at its default.
